crafts.name: Wall Hanging Decor
instructions: Lay out the cardboard
Draw desired shapes and designs on the cardboard
Cut out the shapes and paint them
Hot glue 2-8 toilet paper rolls together lengthwise depending on the desired length of the wall hanging
Hot glue the shapes to the strings, with the number of strings depending on how many rows of shapes and designs you want
Hot glue the strings to the row of toilet paper rolls
Add final touches and hang it up!
crafts.sustainability_note: Cardboard and toilet paper rolls are reused and transformed into a decorative wall hanging.
environmental_benefits: Prevents accumulation in landfills and reduces environmental damage

crafts.name: Cardboard Flower Decor
instructions: Lay out the cardboard on a flat surface
Draw different flower shapes and leaves on the cardboard
Carefully cut out the flowers and leaves
Paint the cardboard pieces in desired colours and let them dry
Arrange the flowers and leaves into a design you like
Hot glue the pieces together to create the flowers
Attach pieces of string to the flowers so they can be hung up
Add final details or designs, then hang up your cardboard flower decor!
crafts.sustainability_note: Cardboard is recycled into a beautiful decorative garland instead of being discarded.
environmental_benefits: Reduces the amount of cardboard sent to landfills
Gives waste materials a new purpose
Helps reduce the need for new craft materials

crafts.name: DIY Photo Frame
instructions: Cut out a rectangle frame from the cardboard
Stick 3 popsicle sticks on their respective sides, leaving one side open as a gap to insert the photo
Hot glue a rectangle cardboard sheet to the back of the sticks
Design and paint the frame and base
Insert your photo and display your handmade photo frame
crafts.sustainability_note: Cardboard and popsicle sticks are recycled into a lightweight DIY photo frame.
environmental_benefits: Gives waste materials a new purpose
Reduces the need for new craft materials

crafts.name: Stained Glass Decor
instructions: Place the cardboard sheet on a flat surface
Cut out the desired shape
Draw your design on the cardboard using a marker
Trace the design with a hot glue gun
Cut the same shape out of the foil
Press the foil into the cardboard, pressing around the glue to reveal the design
Paint the spaces with paint or markers
Hang it up using double-sided tape
crafts.sustainability_note: Cardboard is reused and transformed into a decorative stained glass-style craft.
environmental_benefits: Creates a DIY project that benefits the environment
